Prime Gaming (Amazon Luna) December 2025: Full list of free games for the month

Added: 8mo ago
By Kamil Markiewicz
Want to see more from GG.deals on Google? Add as a source on Google

There are 14 titles lined up for the Christmas season.

Amazon has shared the complete schedule of December freebies for Prime members. Get ready to explore digital wastelands (again), play with LEGOs, and become an augmented human, among other attractions.

This month, we’re getting a total of 14 titles, split across five batches.

You’ll find the full Prime Gaming December 2025 lineup in the section below. The first three games are already available.

Also worth reading:
Prime Gaming (Amazon Luna) kicks off the month with 3 PC games to snag for FREE

Amazon Luna / Prime Gaming December 2025 games

Did Amazon prepare anything special for the Christmas season? Take a look at the Prime Gaming December 2025 schedule and judge for yourself. If you’ve been a member for a while, you’ll probably notice some repeats here…

  • December 4: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection One [GOG Code]
  • December 4: GYLT [Amazon Games App]
  • December 4: LEGO 2K Drive [Epic Games Store]
  • December 11: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection Two [GOG Code]
  • December 11: Christmas Adventure: Candy Storm [Legacy Games Code]
  • December 18: Bō: Path of the Teal Lotus [GOG Code]
  • December 18: Gunslugs 2 [GOG Code]
  • December 18: Ashworld [GOG Code]
  • December 18: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection Three [GOG Code]
  • December 23: Fallout: A Post Nuclear Role Playing Game [GOG Code]
  • December 23: Fallout 2 [GOG Code]
  • December 30: Dreamscaper [Epic Games Store]
  • December 30: Living Legends: The Crystal Tear Collector's Edition [Amazon Games App]
  • December 30: Deus Ex - Mankind Divided [Epic Games Store]

Long story short, if you still don’t have the classic Fallout titles or Deus Ex: Mankind Divided in your collection, Prime is giving you another chance to grab them. One highlight is potentially Bō: Path of the Teal Lotus, a 2.5D Metroidvania steeped in Japanese myths and folk tales. Aside from that, Ashworld offers an open-world survival experience with car crashes across the Ragelands.

First-time subscribers can take advantage of a free 30-day Prime trial, which gives access to all of this month’s lineup.

Free 30-Day Amazon Prime / Prime Gaming Trial

  • 30-Day trial Amazon Prime (USA)
  • 30-Day trial Amazon Prime (Germany)
  • 30-Day trial Amazon Prime (UK)
  • 30-Day trial Amazon Premium (Spain)
  • 30-Day trial Amazon Premium (France)
  • 30-Day trial Amazon Premium (Poland)

Just keep in mind: the trial is a) only available to new members, and b) it automatically renews when it ends, meaning you’ll pay the regular fee unless you cancel beforehand.
